content.short: Cardano Tip Bot allows anyone to tip ADA & tokens on Twitter and Discord.
content.description: Cardano Tip Bot is a Twitter bot and Discord bot that allow anyone to tip ADA & tokens to other users. The project's main purpose is to promote engagement in the Cardano community in a fun way. Assets can be deposited via a unique deposit address per user and assets can be withdrawn to an external wallet at any time.
